context: Four boys—Fred, Juan, Marc, and Paul—and three girls—Nita, Rachel, and Trisha—will be assigned to a row of five adjacent lockers, numbered consecutively 1 through 5, arranged along a straight wall. 5. The remaining boys (Marc, Paul) can be alone or shared, but the question asks who MUST be among those assigned to shared lockers.
6. Only Juan is explicitly required to share (condition). Fred could be alone or shared, but not required. Others are optional.

The correct option is:
